prompt.v: A boat goes 10 miles per hour in still water. It travels 12 miles downstream in the same time it travels 8 miles upstream. How fast is the current, in miles per hour?

problems.explain: Call the current c. Downstream the boat goes 10 + c, upstream 10 − c, and time is distance over speed. The times are equal: 12/(10 + c) = 8/(10 − c). Cross-multiply: 12(10 − c) = 8(10 + c), so 40 = 20c and c = 2.
